title: The Roopkund Skeleton Lake Mystery
hook: Who caused the hundreds of ancient bodies at Roopkund?
headline: Mystery of the Skeleton Lake

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1942, forest ranger Hari Kishan Madhwal rediscovered the skeletons at Roopkund.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Local villagers speak of a hailstorm legend that dates back to the 9th century.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: DNA analysis shows ancestry groups from around 800 CE (South Asian) and from around 1800 CE (Southeast Asian and Eastern Mediterranean).

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2020 study suggested a second group died from a mysterious toxin.

end.line: What really caused the mass deaths at Roopkund?

description: Explore the puzzling discovery of hundreds of skeletons at India's Roopkund Lake.

facts.claim: British explorer Eric Shipton discovered the skeletons in June 1942
Approximately one hundred human skeletons were found at the site
Local villagers reported a severe hailstorm on 23 August 1942 that may have caused deaths
DNA analysis in 2017 linked half the remains to South Asian soldiers from a 1815 British expedition
A 2020 study suggested exposure to a toxin as a possible cause for a second group of victims

bad: unsupported: A 2020 study suggested a second group died from a mysterious toxin
